taskResults.reason: The bank's current published app displays a gold butterfly on a dark field, while the accepted icon is a white butterfly on burgundy. An independent directory displays a dark butterfly on a gold-gradient field in an SVG, but the provenance of that vector and the current applicability of its inverted color variant are unconfirmed. The independently published burgundy-and-white lockup supports a similar variant to the accepted icon but does not establish its present official use or byte-exact equivalence. No appropriate replacement is sufficiently supported; neither a candidate nor unchanged is established.
